html:
About the job

Responsibilities
About the team
We are the Thailand TikTok Shop by Seller Management team, committed to helping small and medium-sized sellers to grow their businesses and succeed on TikTok Shop through seller incubation programs, education activities, campaign/ growth policies and subsidy programs.

Responsibilities:
- Break down complex business problems and design actionable analyses.
- Work with datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks in seller and category performance.
- Develop insights and present clear, structured findings to support decision-making.
- Partner with cross-functional teams to implement recommendations and track outcomes.
- Take ownership of analysis projects from start to finish; proactively identify follow-ups and additional questions.
- Contribute to system-building: create templates, dashboards, or playbooks to streamline recurring analytical tasks.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Minimum Bachelor's Degree or above (STEM (Engineering, Technology, Math, Science), Economics, BBA.)
- Strong business problem breakdown and structured thinking.
- Data analytical capability: basic SQL / structured dataset reasoning.
- Ability to interpret data and derive meaningful insights.
- Strong communication skills; can present insights clearly.
- Ownership mindset: proactive mindset; constantly ask "what's next", curious, and solution-oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience at e-commerce, fintech, or data-driven companies (Lazada, Shopee, Grab, banks, or brands leveraging large datasets).
- Experience translating data into business recommendations and collaborating cross-functionally.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

name: layout-64
title: Assistant Software Test Engineer- OS
html:
About the job

A. Responsible for the local OS experience quality control:

a) In the pre-project period, execute the value assessment to new features to identify and filter out the features with low demands and high experience risks, so as to ensure the better ratio of input-output and user experience.

b) During the project, implement various experience testing methods to ensure the OS experience issues and risks are fully exposed and the evaluation results effectively represent the local users’ evaluation. (the methods include but not limited to novice test, heuristic evaluation, scenario test, scenario evaluation/competitor analysis, trial interview, etc.)

c) During OS experience testing, identify the issue risks, clarify the process and reasons of the issues in details, and promote the optimization with OS experience engineers.

d) After the product launching, arrange various research methods to find and trace the OS experience issues and demands from local users. (the methods include but not limited to local shops/service centers visit, interview, questionnaire survey, VOC analysis, etc.)

B. Insight into local scenarios, continuously optimize the local library of scenarios:

a) Regularly conduct scenarios interviews with local users (including vivo and other brands), and summarize different typical local scenarios, user portraits, issues, demands and perception.

b) Convert user data and language collected from interviews and other channels to library of scenarios (first>second>third-level scenarios>key paths>key control points>operation flows> key driving indicators), to ensure it update in line with perception of local users in time and can help project test and evaluation effectively.

C. Establish and continuously optimize the local OS experience standards or norms:

a) During project testing, scenario interviews and other experience activities, summarize typical issues and demands to standards or norms that can represent how to improve the local OS experience or avoid risks, and determine the direction and priority of experience improvement.

D. Empower other team members with user experience related theories and methods:

a) Regularly arrange the trainings or cases/experience share of user experience to other team members to jointly improve the team's user experience cognition and ability.




Qualification

Qualifications：


Job Requirements

1. Education

Degree: Bachelor’s degree or above.

Major: Human-Computer Interaction, Industrial Design, User Research, or other related fields.

(Mandatory)


2. Language Skills

Thai: Fluent, native level. (Mandatory)

English or Chinese: Fluent, working proficiency. (Mandatory)


3. Knowledge & Expertise

Passionate about mobile phone industry products, with a solid understanding of user experience and future industry development. (Mandatory)

Strong analytical skills in understanding local user demographics, scenarios, and needs, with a keen sensitivity to OS experience issues and potential risks. (Mandatory)

Familiar with user experience principles and methods, including user interviews, surveys/questionnaires, and heuristic evaluation. (Preferred)


4. Project Experience

Experience in usability testing, market analysis, or user research. (Mandatory, full-time work experience preferred)

Experience in the smartphone industry. (Preferred)

5. Others

Curious, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning.

Strong teamwork spirit, sense of responsibility, and excellent communication & coordination skills.

(Mandatory)
